description: This file defines the Bitmap class providing support for bitmaps, including creation, resizing, setting, clearing, toggling, and searching bits, within the disk_cache namespace.

classes.name: disk_cache::Bitmap
classes.description: A class that manages a bitmap, allowing bit manipulation, resizing, and range operations.

methods.name: Bitmap(int num_bits, bool clear_bits)
methods.description: Constructor that allocates bitmap memory aligned to uint32_t boundary, optionally clearing bits.

methods.name: Bitmap(uint32_t* map, int num_bits, int num_words)
methods.description: Constructs a Bitmap with caller-provided storage.

methods.name: Resize(int num_bits, bool clear_bits)
methods.description: Resizes the bitmap, discarding or zero-filling bits as needed.

methods.name: Set(int index, bool value)
methods.description: Sets a specific bit to true or false.

methods.name: Get(int index) const
methods.description: Returns the value of a specific bit.

methods.name: Toggle(int index)
methods.description: Toggles the value of a specific bit.

methods.name: SetMapElement(int array_index, uint32_t value)
methods.description: Sets an element of the internal map directly.

methods.name: GetMapElement(int array_index) const
methods.description: Retrieves an element of the internal map.

methods.name: SetMap(const uint32_t* map, int size)
methods.description: Sets the internal map from an external array.

methods.name: GetMap() const
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal map.

methods.name: SetRange(int begin, int end, bool value)
methods.description: Sets a range of bits to a specific value.

methods.name: TestRange(int begin, int end, bool value) const
methods.description: Checks if any bits in a range are set to a specific value.

methods.name: FindNextBit(int* index, int limit, bool value) const
methods.description: Finds the next bit set to a value starting from index.

methods.name: FindNextSetBitBeforeLimit(int* index, int limit) const
methods.description: Finds the next set bit before a limit.

methods.name: FindNextSetBit(int* index) const
methods.description: Finds the next set bit from current index.

methods.name: FindBits(int* index, int limit, bool value) const
methods.description: Counts consecutive bits set to a value starting from index.
